verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Authy offering a local programmatic endpoint, CLI, or API that lets an agent read a user's vault codes or secrets. The Authy API/SDK is a server-side tool for adding 2FA to third-party apps, which is a different capability, and it is closed to new customers. Community reports say getting at the token seeds required hacky debug-mode scripts, which is a user workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
